title: ¿Por qué un tenedor saca chispas en el microondas y una cuchara no? ⚡
staging_mode_proposal: cutaway: everything happens inside the oven cavity: a cutaway of the microwave keeps the fork, the spoon, the walls and the door mesh in one frame
curiosity_reason: Everyone has been warned about metal in the microwave, and many have seen the sparks; dangerous.
hook_question: ¿Por qué un tenedor saca chispas en el microondas y una cuchara no?
false_belief: Cualquier metal hace chispas dentro del microondas.
turn: Scene 5: the oven's own walls, and even the door's screen, are metal, and they never spark: they are smooth.
closing_reframe: No chispea el metal: chispean las puntas.

description:
¿Por qué un tenedor saca chispas en el microondas y una cuchara no? Porque la carga se amontona en las puntas de sus dientes y rompe el aire.
Y el propio microondas está hecho de metal, solo que liso. ⚡
Envíaselo a ese amigo que mete al microondas el plato con el tenedor encima.

scenes.name: hook
scenes.narration: ¿Por qué un tenedor saca chispas en el microondas y una cuchara no? Dicen que cualquier metal chispea.
scenes.what_changes: Contrast, two actors: a cut-away microwave with a fork and a spoon on the turning plate; the fork crackles with sparks at its tines while the spoon stays dark; tag ¿CUALQUIER METAL? appears.
scenes.transformation: tenedor y cuchara quietos → el tenedor chispea y la cuchara no
scenes.camera: órbita lenta alrededor del plato giratorio

elements.name: microwave oven (cutaway)
elements.route: library: Poly Haven 'Vintage Microwave' (BlenderKit cab01678, CC0, 138 MB) or BlenderKit 'Low Poly Microwave Oven' (c629cd93, RF); the open job `microwave-oven` brief (states door closed, open, cutaway showing metal walls) is the spec, built by the production under asset-system (g)
elements.risk: medium: an unsealed class; a box with a window door, keypad and glass plate is a strong read

elements.name: fork and spoon on a plate
elements.route: build, geometric (fork, spoon, glass plate); library alternative BlenderKit 'fork' (1142edef, RF)

scenes.name: ondas
scenes.narration: Adentro, las microondas rebotan de pared en pared, y su campo cambia de sentido miles de millones de veces por segundo: empuja las cargas del metal de un lado a otro.
scenes.what_changes: The cavity fills with accent wave fronts bouncing between the walls; inside the fork and the spoon a glow sloshes from one end to the other in time with them.
scenes.transformation: horno vacío de ondas → las ondas rebotan y la carga va y viene dentro del metal
scenes.camera: travelling lateral a través de la cavidad, de pared a pared

elements.name: glowing waves bouncing inside a microwave cavity
elements.route: energy graphics (emissive rings, doctrine language) inside the oven build
elements.risk: medium: energy graphics need the oven walls in frame

scenes.name: puntas
scenes.narration: En la cuchara, la carga se reparte por toda la curva. En el tenedor, se amontona en las cuatro puntas de los dientes.
scenes.what_changes: Close-up side by side: the glow spreads evenly over the spoon's bowl, while on the fork it drains into the four tine tips, which brighten one by one.
scenes.transformation: carga repartida en ambos → la cuchara queda pareja y las puntas del tenedor se encienden
scenes.camera: empuje desde la cuchara hacia las puntas del tenedor
overlays_plan: ring dotted around the tines at 'puntas'

elements.name: fork tines glowing
elements.route: fork build with an emissive tip mask

scenes.name: chispa
scenes.narration: Ahí el empuje es tan fuerte que rompe el aire: el aire se vuelve chispa, como un rayo en miniatura.
scenes.what_changes: The air at the tines breaks down: arcs leap between the tips with a flash, branch and snap off.
scenes.transformation: puntas brillantes → saltan chispas entre los dientes
scenes.camera: primer plano que retrocede de golpe con cada chispa

elements.name: sparks between fork tines
elements.route: build: small branching emissive arcs under the open job `electric-arc` brief (state 'small arc between two points')
elements.risk: medium: an unsealed class; the fork is the context cue

scenes.name: giro
scenes.narration: Pero las paredes del microondas también son de metal, y no chispean: son lisas, sin puntas. Hasta la rejilla de la puerta es metal.
scenes.what_changes: The turn: pull-back to the whole cutaway oven; its walls light evenly, without a single spark; the camera pushes to the door, where the metal screen behind the glass lights as a fine grid.
scenes.transformation: chispas en el tenedor → todo el horno se ilumina parejo, sin chispas, hasta la rejilla de la puerta
scenes.camera: retroceso a todo el horno y empuje hacia la puerta

elements.name: microwave door with its metal screen
elements.route: oven build/import; the screen is a geometric perforated plate behind the window

scenes.name: cierre
scenes.narration: Así que no chispea el metal: chispean las puntas. Envíaselo a ese amigo que mete al microondas el plato con el tenedor encima.
scenes.what_changes: Single reframe image: the fork's four tips spark once more beside the dark, smooth spoon, while the whole oven glows calmly around them.
scenes.transformation: tenedor y cuchara → las puntas chispean y todo lo liso queda tranquilo
scenes.camera: retroceso desde las puntas hasta el horno entero

sources: Mechanism: the oven's field drives charge in the metal; charge gathers at sharp points (field enhancement) until the air breaks down into a spark; smooth objects without points usually do not arc, though they can under some conditions: NPR 'Science Out of the Box: Microwave antics, don't stick a fork in it' (3 November 2006) and Physics Forums 'Metal in microwave ovens' (live search 2026-11-11). FLAGGED: add one physics or manufacturer reference at the beat sheet.

Oven frequency about 2.45 GHz (patent literature and EMF-Portal, live search 2026-11-11); the field reverses direction about 4.9 billion times a second, so 'miles de millones de veces por segundo' holds.

The oven's metal case and a metal-wire screen in the door keep the microwaves inside: Swiss Federal Office of Public Health fact sheet 'Microwave ovens'; UL 'Radarange to modern-day microwaves' (screen holes about 1 mm) (live search 2026-11-11).
simplifications: A spoon CAN arc in some conditions (edges, size, field pattern); the hook question states the common case and the narration says the spoon's charge spreads out, not that a spoon never sparks.
Waves and charge are drawn as glows; both are invisible.
